subject: Request: Peak Surge Allowance for POC Latency Run (Finex)
messages:
From: Anna Torres <anna@finex-analytics.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-24T14:08:00-07:00
Subject: POC - short notice peak run request

Hi Jasmine,

Hope you9are well. We're ramping up a short POC to validate latency at peak traffic for our inference pipelines next week. The engineering team wants to run a 2-hour spike that simulates 3x our normal QPS to surface tail-latency and queueing behavior.

Can Redwood provision an extra trial allowance / promotional credits for a single stress window? We9d like to run:
- 2 hours continuous
- target concurrency: 3x baseline (~2k concurrent requests)
- 99th pct latency goal: < 350ms

Attached is the mini test plan and expected request distribution.

Timing: Prefer Wed 2026-09-30 08:00-10:00 PT. This is a hard date for our internal stakeholders.

Thanks,
Anna Torres
Head of MLOps, Finex Analytics
Anna@finex-analytics.com

Attachments: POC-plan.pdf, throughput-schedule.csv

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Torres <anna@finex-analytics.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-24T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC - short notice peak run request

Hi Anna 9-- thanks for the details and the plan. We can usually support short stress windows but need an approval for a temporary surge allowance on your trial account.

Can you confirm the HubSpot deal id (if available) and whether this run will include any sensitive customer data? Also copying Ben (sales ops) to scope the promotional allowance.

If we get sign-off by Mon EOD we can schedule the burst and pre-warm the cache to avoid cold-start artifacts.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-25T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC - short notice peak run request

Jasmine / Marissa --

I reviewed Finex's usage and the deal FINEX-1872. They9ve been active in the trial and this request is narrowly-scoped (2 hours). I'm OK approving a one-time promotional allowance to cover the expected token/run cost for the spike, provided we capture a short MAD (mutual action plan) and a signed SOW or purchase intent from the customer afterwards.

Recommend: allocate a "burst allowance" equivalent to $2,500 in hosting credits and require the customer to acknowledge the test window and not to escalate more than the agreed concurrency. Also approve the SLA-exception-form to be completed for the run.

Marissa - can you add the allocation to the trial account and fill the HubSpot deal note?

Thanks,
Ben
Senior Sales Ops, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Anna Torres <anna@finex-analytics.com>
Date: 2026-09-28T11:26:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC - short notice peak run request

Anna / team --

All set on our side. I9ve provisioned a one-time burst allowance (internal credit id: BRST-2026-091) worth $2,500 to Finex's trial account, active for 2026-09-30 07:00-12:00 PT (buffer window).

Action items:
- Anna: Please sign the attached SLA-exception-form and reply-all confirming you're good to proceed at 08:00 PT on 09/30.
- Jasmine: I'll add the HubSpot deal note and attach the SLA paperwork.
- Ben: please confirm whether we want to mark this as trial goodwill or promotional spend against the Q4 trial budget.

Regards,

Sr. Customer Success Ops, Redwood Inference

From: Anna Torres <anna@finex-analytics.com>

Date: 2026-09-30T11:42:00-07:00

Anna
